models.name: MA320U
models.notes: Verified live on macOS 26 / Apple M4 Pro over DisplayPort 1.4. Ranges and write behaviour come from crispctl reads and write-verified round trips (see reference/benq-ma320u.md). The input mapping below is NOT verified.

input.notes: The panel has USB-C, DisplayPort, HDMI-1 and HDMI-2. Only one code is known, so this list is deliberately NOT complete and the app keeps offering the generic VESA codes alongside it.

values.label: USB-C
values.notes: UNCONFIRMED. The panel reports current input source 19, which is not a meaningful VESA MCCS code (0x13 would be 'DVI-10' and this monitor has no DVI). The Mac is attached over the USB-C port, so 19 is very likely USB-C, but nobody has switched away and back to prove it. Kept at 'reported' on purpose: the app shows it as 'USB-C?' and asks before writing it. Do not promote to 'verified' without doing the calibration in README.md.
